zh.title: 國防部偵獲8共機8共艦與4公務船於台海活動
zh.summary: 國防部偵獲八架次共機與八艘次共艦，其中四架次侵擾西南及東部空域
body: 國防部於2026年9月8日公布共機與共艦之最新動態。統計自9月7日上午6時起至8日上午6時止，共偵獲8艘次共艦、4艘次公務船，以及8架次共機，持續在台海周邊活動。
在偵獲的共機中，其中共有4架次侵擾了西南及東部空域。針對此一動態，國軍運用了任務機、任務艦以及岸置飛彈系統進行嚴密監控與因應處置。
根據本站統計紀錄顯示，台海周邊前一日（9月7日）共記錄到共機2架次、共艦13艘及公務船4艘。此外，台海近30日（共19筆紀錄）之日平均值，則分別為共機5.5架次與共艦7.9艘。

en.title: MND Detects 8 Chinese Military Aircraft and 8 Vessels Around Taiwan
en.summary: MND detected eight Chinese aircraft and eight vessels operating around Taiwan over the past day.
body: The Ministry of National Defense released the latest movements of Chinese military aircraft and vessels on September 8, 2026. From 6:00 AM on September 7 to 6:00 AM on September 8, a total of eight Chinese military vessels, four official vessels, and eight Chinese military aircraft sorties were detected operating around the Taiwan Strait.

Among the detected aircraft, four sorties entered Taiwan's southwest and eastern airspace. In response, Taiwan's military deployed mission aircraft, naval vessels, and shore-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond to the activities.

According to database statistics recorded by this site, the previous day on September 7 saw two military aircraft sorties, 13 military vessels, and four official vessels. Over the past 30 days, the daily averages stood at 5.5 aircraft sorties and 7.9 vessels.
